Ava / Marissa — I saw Elaine's note. Quick summary of what we can do and constraints:

- We have a completed SOC 2 Type II report covering audit period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (internal control report). Can share the report under NDA.
- For customers needing an attestation dated within 30 days, we can issue an "interim attestation" (signed statement from Security & Compliance) that confirms controls in place and that there have been no material exceptions since the report period. This is not a replacement for a full Type II but is accepted by many procurement teams as a stopgap.
- We can produce a one-page bridge letter draft today and circulate for signature. Legal will need to sign off on the exact language.

ETA/next steps I propose:
1) I will prepare the interim attestation and bridge letter draft today and attach a redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf that lists scope & coverage for procurement review.
2) Karthik to export the SIG/CAIQ answers (we will flag any high-risk responses) and attach.
3) We share draft with Ava/Marissa for commercial cover and then send to Elaine with attachments, requesting expedited review.

Risks: large custom attestations take longer — keep to a short factual statement. If Acme requests contractual language changes to the bridge, that may require legal review that could add 48-72 hours.

I'll start the draft now.

-Rishi
